issue.notes:
[migrated comment from bf-l0y, 2026-07-30T03:21:59.631357Z, author cli]
Concrete gap found in plan-vs-artifacts audit (2026-07-29). Both index.html (line 11) and user.html (lines 11 and 16) reference https://vibecodeleaderboard.com/og-image.png in their og:image / twitter:image meta tags, but no image file exists anywhere in the repo (git ls-files shows zero .png/.ico/.svg/.jpg/.webp assets). Every social-share unfurl therefore points at a 404, so even the default share card renders blank.

This is NOT covered by bf-46h: that bead is scoped to dynamic per-user OG injection via a Cloudflare Pages Function under functions/u/<username>, and it assumes the static default og-image.png already exists (it notes generateOGImageUrl() always returns the static default og-image.png). The main leaderboard page (index.html) is entirely outside bf-46h's /u/<username> scope and will still reference a nonexistent image after bf-46h ships.

Acceptance criteria:
- A branded og-image.png (recommended 1200x630) exists at the repo root so it resolves at /og-image.png once deployed per ADR-001.
- index.html and user.html og:image / twitter:image meta tags resolve to a real 200 asset (verify after deploy or against a local static server).
- The default social card renders correctly for the main leaderboard page and for any /u/<username> profile before bf-46h per-user image work lands.
- Optional adjacent nicety: neither index.html nor user.html references a favicon (no rel=icon link at all); consider adding one in the same pass, but the load-bearing gap is the missing og-image.png.

Files: index.html, user.html, new og-image.png at repo root.
issue.title: Add the missing og-image.png social-share asset referenced by index.html and user.html

issue.description: js/report.js ReportGenerator.generate() and js/profile.js loadFromAPI() both assume https://api.<hostname> is reachable. Verified 2026-07-20: the domain has no DNS record and the paired backend (claude-leaderboard Deployment on apexalgo-iad) is scaled to 0/0 replicas (see docs/plan/plan.md). Today, clicking 'Generate Report' opens a modal that hangs on a dead EventSource with no timeout, and profile.js silently mislabels API-unreachable as 'user not found'. Add a short-timeout reachability check (e.g. fetch with AbortController, ~2s timeout, to ${API_BASE}/health) before opening the report modal in js/report.js and before the API fallback in js/profile.js loadUserData(); on failure show an explicit 'report generation is temporarily unavailable' message instead of hanging or mislabeling. Files: js/report.js, js/profile.js, js/app.js (showGenerateReportOption).
issue.title: Gate Generate-Report / live-API profile fallback behind a reachability check

issue.close_reason: Implemented bounded leaderboard row virtualization with viewport overscan, spacer rows, scroll recycling, and incremental Load More updates; shipped in 2209118 and verified with node syntax and DOM-window smoke tests.
issue.description: js/app.js renderLeaderboard() rebuilds the full visible slice (tbody.innerHTML = pageData.map(...).join('')) on every 'Load More' click, and loadLeaderboard() fetches the entire leaderboard.json unconditionally on page load with no pagination. The site's own meta description claims '152K+ users, 7M+ commits' scale - at that size this means a multi-MB JSON fetch plus an ever-growing full DOM rebuild instead of incremental append. Add row virtualization/windowing (e.g. render only rows near the viewport, append-only instead of full innerHTML replace on Load More) so DOM node count stays bounded regardless of total leaderboard size. File: js/app.js (renderLeaderboard, loadMore).
issue.title: Virtualize the leaderboard table instead of full-array re-render on Load More

issue.close_reason: Added explicit width/height attributes to all avatar tags to prevent layout shift. Modified 4 locations across js/app.js (renderUserRow, showUserResult, showMultipleUserResults, showGenerateReportOption) and js/profile.js (renderProfile), setting dimensions that match CSS: 40x40 for .user-avatar, 60x60 for .user-result-avatar, and 80x80 for .profile-avatar. This reserves layout space before images decode, eliminating CLS during lazy loading in the leaderboard table.
issue.description: Avatar tags in js/app.js (renderUserRow, showUserResult) and js/profile.js (renderProfile) don't set explicit width/height or use aspect-ratio CSS, causing layout shift (CLS) as each avatar image loads - most visible on the leaderboard table where dozens of avatars load at once via loading=lazy. Add explicit width/height attributes matching the CSS-rendered avatar size (see .user-avatar / .profile-avatar rules in css/style.css and css/profile.css) so layout is stable before images decode. Files: js/app.js, js/profile.js, css/style.css, css/profile.css.
issue.title: Add explicit width/height to avatar tags to prevent layout shift

Commit+push declarative-config per its own git discipline (git pull --rebase, push immediately). Do not carry over the old workflow's 'fetch leaderboard.json from API during deploy' step - see the separate placeholder-data bead in this repo.

issue.close_reason: Replaced deprecated document.execCommand('copy') with modern Clipboard API (navigator.clipboard.writeText) as primary method, with execCommand fallback for non-HTTPS contexts. Added proper error handling and user feedback.
issue.description: js/profile.js window.copyShareUrl() uses the deprecated document.execCommand('copy') (deprecated per MDN, unreliable in some browsers/contexts). Replace with navigator.clipboard.writeText(url) as the primary path, keeping execCommand only as a fallback for contexts without the Clipboard API (e.g. non-HTTPS local dev via python -m http.server). File: js/profile.js (copyShareUrl).
issue.title: Replace deprecated document.execCommand('copy') with Clipboard API

issue.description: js/app.js handleSearch() only matches u.username.toLowerCase() === query.toLowerCase() against the baked-in leaderboard - no partial/substring matching, and it only fires on button click or Enter (no live/debounced search-as-you-type). Add debounced (~200ms) input-driven substring search with a small results list, falling back to the existing exact-match 'Generate Report' prompt only when zero substring matches are found. Files: js/app.js (setupEventListeners, handleSearch), index.html (search input).
issue.title: Add debounced substring search instead of exact-username-match-only

issue.description: Implements docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001. Delete .github/workflows/deploy.yml (it has failed on both of its runs ever - missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID secrets, and its optional leaderboard.json refresh step fails because api.vibecodeleaderboard.com has no DNS record). Also disable GitHub Actions at the repo-settings level on both github.com/jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend and github.com/ardenone/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend - deleting the workflow file alone does not stop a repo with Actions enabled from re-triggering on a future push (known fleet gotcha). Verify with 'gh run list -R jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend' showing no new runs after the next push. This repo's origin is Forgejo (git.ardenone.com/jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend), which push-mirrors to both GitHub orgs.

issue.description: js/profile.js updateMetaTags() mutates <meta property=og:*> tags client-side after DOMContentLoaded, but link-unfurl crawlers (Slack, X/Twitter, Discord, iMessage) fetch raw HTML and do not execute JavaScript - every /u/<username> share currently unfurls as the generic 'Vibe Code Leaderboard' card, never the per-user rank/stats this feature (commit 8faf52d, bf-4g1a) was built to show. generateOGImageUrl() in js/profile.js also always returns the static default og-image.png regardless of user - there is no dynamic per-user OG image generation at all. Fix: add a Cloudflare Pages Function (e.g. functions/u/[username].js) that reads leaderboard.json (and/or the API once live) server-side and injects real og:title/og:description/og:image into the HTML response before it reaches crawlers, keeping the existing client-side js/profile.js for the interactive page. Files: user.html, js/profile.js, new functions/ directory. References docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001 (same Cloudflare Pages deployment this depends on).
issue.title: Render per-user Open Graph tags server-side so social unfurls actually work

issue.close_reason: Added a visible 'Demo Data' banner that automatically appears when leaderboard.json contains synthetic testuserNNN entries. The banner features a pulsing orange gradient design with the message '🚧 Demo Data — This leaderboard is currently showing placeholder test data. Real data coming soon!' The implementation includes: (1) a new banner section in index.html, (2) prominent CSS styling with animation in style.css, and (3) JavaScript logic in app.js that detects the testuserNNN pattern and conditionally displays the banner. This prevents visitors from being misled into thinking the placeholder data represents real GitHub users and statistics, satisfying the requirement to label demo data before the site is promoted or linked publicly.
issue.description: leaderboard.json as committed ships testuser088/089/090/... entries with an identical stat block each (497 commits, 174 commits_30d, 5 repos, same recent_repos pattern) - synthetic fixture data, not real leaderboard content. Per docs/plan/plan.md, the real backend is scaled to 0/0 and its replacement (devimprint pipeline) isn't wired up yet. Until real data exists: add a visible 'demo data' banner in index.html whenever the data source is the baked-in JSON, so a real visitor isn't misled into thinking these are real GitHub users/stats. Must be resolved (or the banner added) before the site, once deployed per ADR-001, is promoted or linked publicly. Files: leaderboard.json, index.html, js/app.js (updateStats/loadLeaderboard).
issue.title: Replace synthetic testuserNNN placeholder data in leaderboard.json or label it as demo data
